title: Deterministic Subexponential-Time Algorithm for Elliptic-Curve & Prime-Field DLP
aiSystem: OpenAI Cauchy–Hermite Tensor-Contraction Engine (Oct 2026 ETH Refutation)
whyItMatters: Assuming OpenAI’s AI-discovered Cauchy–Hermite tensor-contraction theorem, gives a deterministic subexponential p^o(1) algorithm for both elliptic-curve and prime-field discrete logarithms with zero randomness.
summary: Building directly on OpenAI’s October 2026 AI-discovered Cauchy–Hermite Boolean tensor-contraction construction (and advancing Akshima et al.’s October 28 randomized subexponential ECDLP algorithm), Shuchang Liu, Bingsheng Zhang, and Kui Ren (Zhejiang University, IACR ePrint 2026/3020) construct a uniform deterministic multitape Turing machine solving the discrete logarithm problem on both prime-order elliptic curves E(F_p) and prime fields F_p* in worst-case time 2^{O(b/√(log log b))} = p^{o(1)} and space 2^{O(b/(log b)^{1/4})}. The algorithm requires zero random bits and relies on neither the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis nor smoothness heuristics.
technicalHighlights: Solves both prime-order elliptic-curve DLP over E(F_p) and prime-field DLP in F_p* deterministically in worst-case time 2^{O(b/√(log log b))} = p^{o(1)} using zero random bits.
Combines deterministic conditional-expectation construction of small affine-interval factor bases whose k-fold sumsets cover the group with a terminal-preserving partial tensor-contraction procedure.

Extends Akshima et al.’s October 28, 2026 randomized 2^{O(b/(log b)^{1/4})} ECDLP reduction by eliminating all randomness, GRH dependencies, and smoothness heuristics, conditional on OpenAI’s Oct 2026 contraction theorem.
caveats: Strictly asymptotic and conditional on OpenAI’s unrefereed October 2026 Cauchy–Hermite tensor-contraction theorem, which yields asymptotic savings only above astronomical network sizes (≥ 2^{2^17}); deployed curves such as P-256 and Ed25519 are completely unaffected in practice.
institutions: Zhejiang University (State Key Laboratory of Blockchain and Data Security)
